dsDescriptionValue.value:
The data for the paper entitled: "Spatial Knowledge: A Potential to Enhance Public Participation?" published in Sustainability journal, DOI: 10.3390/su12125025.
Data was collected from the questionnaire, interviews, and focus group discussion with stakeholders of Musrenbang practices in Deli Serdang district, Indonesia. Most of the data was written in Indonesian language.
